title: site-ops-standup-scratchpad
content:
Daily standup scratchpad - Field deployment (Customer: AzuraMed)
Owner: Ava M. // local mobile 
Date notes started: 2026-03-03 // last touched 2026-03-09

Quick context (reminder):
- Private deployment: single-site VPC + on-prem rack (3 x A100 nodes), Redwood Private control-plane in customer VPC (peering).
- Customer network team is cautious: strict ACLs, internal DNS, and HSM-managed keys. Bring spare certs and pre-signed CSR flow notes.

Top priorities for today
- Finish VLAN tagging with customer: app vlan 120, mgmt vlan 200, storage vlan 210 (confirm annotated PDU map).
- Validate cross-account KMS flow (API access from control plane) — get final KMS principal from Seema before rolling.
- Smoke test inference pipeline (end-to-end): upload small model, run streaming response test, check latency and CPU/GPU utilization.

To-do (ordered):
1) Rack & power
   - Verify rack elevations: nodes in U10-U12, switch in U8. Confirm unit markings with onsite label (customer uses vendor label format; I added sticky notes).
   - PDU mapping: left PDU A feeds node1/2; PDU B feeds node3 and switch. Take photos.
   - Bring spare IEC cables (2x) and 1x 1U tray screws (we were short last time).

2) Network/config
   - On switch: set up access VLAN 200 on mgmt ports; make sure SSH from Redwood bastion allowed (customer ACL may block 22 externally).
   - Static routes: customer will peer; they asked for BGP later but for today use static route: 10.50.0.0/24 -> control-plane gw 10.20.1.1.
   - Firewall: request 443 outbound to control plane ip, 2379 to etcd cluster port (internal only). Confirm with Seema.

3) OS + drivers
   - Ubuntu 22.04 LTS minimal image (customer requested minimal). Ensure kernel 5.15.x and NV driver 535.112 or newer (we had GPU issues on 520).
   - Disable swap, set vm.swappiness=1, add nvidia-docker runtime.
   - Docker runtime notes: customer policy blocks registry access; must use local registry mirror. Bring pre-pulled tarballs for redwood-runtime: redwood-serving:v2.1.

4) Security & keys
   - HSM/KMS: customer wants attested signing of model weights hashing. Need to run measurement flow with HSM team.
   - TLS certs: we provisioned certs for api.redwood.local (internal CNAME). Keep CA cert bundle handy.

5) Redwood runtime bootstrap
   - Steps: install runtime tar -> systemctl enable redwood-runtime -> set /etc/redwood/config.yaml with model_path and kv_cache_dir -> start.
   - Config overrides: set batching.max_tokens=2048, kv_cache=true, quant_profile=fp16-8bit (customer ok with reduced perf if stable).

6) Smoke tests and metrics
   - Run: curl -s -X POST https://localhost:8443/v1/generate -d '{"input":"hello"}' (use local certs).
   - Check metrics endpoint: /metrics and Prometheus scrape on :9100. Burst test: 20 concurrent requests, record p95 latency target < 120ms for short prompts.

Known blockers / gotchas (notes to self):
- Customer NOC blocks outbound UDP NTP -> our time drift caused cert validation issues last time. Bring small stratum1 NTP box config; set chrony to fall back.
- HSM team needs IP whitelisted; they require ticket ENG-2742 to be attached to change window. Confirm before 11:00 local.
- Storage node had intermittent SMART warnings on last visit (node2). Plan: run smartctl -a on each disk and snapshot logs. Bring spare NVMe if allowed.
- SELinux is set to enforcing on customer hosts; we should request temporary permissive during install for troubleshooting.

Commands I will run (cheat list)
- ssh redwood@bastion -A
- rsync -avz --progress ./runtime/ redwood@10.50.0.5:/opt/redwood/runtime/
- sudo systemctl restart redwood-runtime && journalctl -fu redwood-runtime -o cat
- nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu,temperature.gpu --format=csv
- curl -k --cert client.pem:client.key https://localhost:8443/v1/generate -d '{"input":"test"}'

Parts & kit to bring (checklist):
- 2x IEC C13 -> C14 spare
- 1x spare NVMe (1TB) + SATA->NVMe mounting kit
- 1x USB-internal serial adapter
- 2x ethernet patch cables (Cat6) 1m
- Spare signed certs (pkcs12) and CSR templates

Escalation & contacts (quick):
- Oncall SRE: Devon Cho (pager), slack @devon-ops
- Field engineer backup: Priya Nair (cell: xxx-xxx-xxxx)
- HSM integration lead: Seema Verma (email: seema@azuramed.com)

Loose questions to resolve (for meeting):
- Confirm whether customer wants model artifacts stored on encrypted LVM (I suggested yes) or separate encrypted directory managed by HSM keys.
- Do they want automatic OS updates? (I recommended no; prefer scheduled window)
- Will they allow outbound Docker to our staging registry? If not, we need to push images to their mirror (we have tarball fallback).

Post-install follow-ups
- Upload photos of rack & cable mapping to ENG-2742 and tag Devon.
- Save model hash and HSM attestation to Confluence page (conf link todo).
- Run post-deploy evals and compare against baseline latency numbers; file any regressions as ENG-2801.

Notes to self (handy):
- Keep install steps idempotent: add --force flags to scripts but log changes.
- If control-plane pairing fails, check mtu mismatches (old switch had MTU 1500 -> caused gRPC chunking problems).

End of scratchpad.
Unresolved: need Seema's KMS principal and confirmation on NTP policy.

-- Ava M.
